description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, Backend (Trading) based in the United States. 

 The Software Engineer, Backend (Trading) will help build and scale the technology powering next-generation digital asset trading experiences. This role focuses on developing robust APIs, data pipelines, and backend services that connect blockchain infrastructure with intuitive user-facing products. The successful candidate will contribute to integrating new trading protocols, aggregators, and transaction types across multiple blockchain ecosystems. They will also help explore new trading experiences and product opportunities, shaping how users discover and execute digital asset transactions. Working in a fully remote, collaborative engineering environment, they will have opportunities to influence product direction and engage directly with users and developers. This is an opportunity to solve complex technical challenges while helping make open financial markets more accessible worldwide.



Accountabilities
 

 
 Design, develop, and maintain APIs, data pipelines, and backend services that support trading experiences across multiple blockchain ecosystems.



 
 Lead the implementation and integration of new trading protocols, aggregators, and transaction types.



 
 Develop and optimize backend infrastructure connecting blockchain networks with seamless, reliable user experiences.



 
 Contribute to new trading initiatives, including experimentation with emerging trading interfaces, user segments, and product opportunities.



 
 Own and deliver features across web-based platforms, including browser extension experiences and the company website.



 
 Lead technical initiatives to introduce support for additional blockchains and launch complementary products and infrastructure.



 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build scalable, secure, and intuitive trading solutions.



 
 Engage directly with end users and developers, providing technical support and gathering feedback to inform product improvements and priorities.



 
 Contribute to engineering team growth and help foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.




 Requirements:


 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.



 
 5+ years of full-time professional software engineering experience.



 
 Strong backend engineering skills, with experience designing and implementing APIs, services, and data pipelines.



 
 Demonstrated interest in open, decentralized, and community-driven platforms.



 
 Ability to work on complex technical challenges involving blockchain infrastructure and digital asset trading systems.



 
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take ownership of projects and deliver reliable solutions.



 
 Excellent collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to engage with users, developers, and cross-functional stakeholders.



 
 English language proficiency.



 
 Experience working with trading systems is a plus.




 Benefits:


 
 Competitive annual base salary ranging from $200,000 to $250,000 USD, depending on skills, relevant experience, interview performance, and market factors such as location.



 
 Equity compensation.



 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, with the base plan fully covered by the employer.



 
 Flexible working hours within a supportive, fully remote environment.



 
 Unlimited paid vacation.



 
 401(k) retirement plan.



 
 Wellness stipend.



 
 Weekly meal stipend.



 
 Learning and development stipend.



 
 Remote work and home office setup stipend.
